stem: How did artists who produced works such as this reflect changes in U.S. society during the nineteenth century?

options.label: A
options.text: They promoted the natural resources of the United States to encourage trade with businesses in Europe.

options.label: B
options.text: They attempted to bring unity to the United States as a response to growing regional tensions within the country.

options.label: C
options.text: They created pieces to celebrate the connection between European culture and the natural heritage of the United States.

options.label: D
options.text: They showed a romantic attitude about nature as a response to increasing industrialization in the United States.

visual_elements: Sunset (California Scenery), 1864 - black and white painting of nature with mountains, trees, lake, and sky.
